title: hieracium amplexicaule subsp. fouresii
intro: Hieracium amplexicaule subsp. fouresii, commonly known as a type of hawkweed, is a plant species that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium amplexicaule subsp. fouresii are believed to be attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit hepatoprotective and gastroprotective properties. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium amplexicaule subsp. fouresii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
